technical.summary: Strong trend structure with ADX 45 and price above major MAs, but momentum oscillators show bearish cross signals and oversold conditions with squeeze limiting volatility expansion—suitable for swing entry on breakout confirmation rather than immediate entry.

fundamental.summary: No detectable insider or institutional signals with earnings in 13 days creates elevated volatility risk; insufficient data for conviction.

sentiment.summary: Fear-driven market (VIX-proxy at 30) presents contrarian buying opportunity despite mixed AAII sentiment; no congressional signals to evaluate.

risk.summary: Normal yield curve and no imminent events support entry, but elevated VIX (25.6) introduces meaningful volatility risk for swing trading.

debate.key_bull_argument: Strong trend structure (ADX 45, price above EMA-200, supertrend bullish) with contrarian fear-zone entry opportunity provides technical confluence for swing entry despite near-term momentum weakness.
debate.key_bear_argument: High earnings risk in 13 days combined with multiple oversold oscillator signals (stoch bearish cross, Williams %R, StochRSI), BB squeeze, and weak fundamental/insider conviction creates execution uncertainty and elevated gap risk.

decision.entry_rationale: Strong trend structure (ADX 45, price above EMA-200, supertrend bullish) with contrarian fear-zone opportunity, but execution delayed until momentum oscillators confirm reversal and earnings volatility risk clears.
decision.primary_risk: Earnings event in 13 days creates gap risk; multiple oversold signals (stoch bearish cross, Williams %R, StochRSI) and BB squeeze suggest momentum exhaustion without confirmation of reversal.
